purpose: Record the original eight-connection schema fixture and independent SQLite-only reproduction of the MIPS contention deadline.
interpretation: The original eight writers and all source assertions remain. Only the slow-target test fixture deadline changes; production SqliteConnection still defaults to 5000 ms. A SQLite-only eight-writer program also failed with the shorter deadline and succeeded with 30000 ms; one timed successful run took 4.09 seconds. This is measured emulator contention evidence, not a proven SQLite defect or physical-router result.
repro_notes: Standalone diagnostic source uses only the C++ standard library and the same SQLite archive, with no TEAQL objects, arenas or schema code. Its default deadline is 30000 ms; replace that fixture constant with 5000 for the original diagnostic. It is not part of the production kernel or the CTest source-coverage count.
